camel_example: aliyun ossutil api put-style --bucket examplebucket --region cn-hangzhou --style-name imagestyle
description_en: Creates an image style. An image style can contain one or more image processing parameters
description_zh: 新增图片样式。一个图片样式中可以包含单个或多个图片处理参数
name: PutStyle

parameters.help_en:
The style category.

Valid values: image, document, and video
parameters.name: category

fields.help_en:
The content of the image style. An image style can contain one or more image processing operations.

An image style that contains a single image processing operation. For example, image/resize,p_50 indicates that the source image is scaled to 50%.

An image style that contains multiple image processing operations. For example, image/resize,p_63/quality,q_90 indicates that the image is first scaled to 63% of the source image, and then the relative quality of the image is set to 90%
fields.help_zh:
图片样式内容，图片样式可以包含一个或多个图片处理操作。

包含单个图片处理操作的图片样式，例如image/resize,p_50，表示将原图缩放50%。

包含多个图片处理操作的图片样式，例如image/resize,p_63/quality,q_90，表示先将图片缩放到原图的63%，再设置图片相对质量为90%
fields.name: content

parameters.help_en: The container that stores the image style information list
parameters.help_zh: 保存图片样式信息列表的容器
parameters.name: style

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The request body that contains the image style information
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 保存图片样式信息的请求体
v1_body_parameters.name: body
